events.title: Chains of Reality Demo: Update 1
events.summary: Hey everyone, Not a major update or anything, just wanted to let you all know i've enabled the first Otherworld for you to explore. The demo was kind of short and left you not wanting to figure out more of the lore since there wasn't a lot, and this new mini-zone will really help with that. Here you'll be able to learn some lore and experience more of the game. I've also recoded and changed somethings as well. Thank you for playing so far! events.title: Chains of Reality (Demo) is officially available to the public!
events.summary: Hey everyone,I'm so excited to finally announce that the demo is officially live! In the demo, you can expect a functioning menu, settings, as well as the full introduction sequence to the game, and level 1. Completing the demo unlocks an option to skip straight to level 1, and skips all cutscenes. Please report any bugs, as I will get right to fixing them up.
